evidence.snippet: As a first step toward constructing high-quality test suites, we introduce SWE-Mutation, a benchmark for evaluating LLM-generated test suites.

claire_radar.motivation: Evaluating software engineering capabilities has become a core component of modern large language models (LLMs); however, the key bottleneck hindering further scaling lies not in the scarcity of high-quality solutions, but in the lack of high-quality test suites.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: High-quality test suites are critical for program repair and reinforcement learning signals. SWE-Mutation reveals inadequacies in LLM-generated tests, guiding improvements in code generation and validation.
